* This class is used internally by the Protocol Buffer library and generated message * implementations. It is public only because those generated messages do not reside in the {@code * protobuf} package. Others should not use this class directly. * *

This class contains constants and helper functions useful for dealing with the Protocol Buffer * wire format. * * @author kenton@google.com Kenton Varda

variables.name: MESSAGE_SET_ITEM
variables.comment: Field numbers for fields in MessageSet wire format.

methods.name: public static int getTagWireType(final int tag)
methods.comment: Given a tag value, determines the wire type (the lower 3 bits).

methods.name: public static int getTagFieldNumber(final int tag)
methods.comment: Given a tag value, determines the field number (the upper 29 bits).

methods.name: static int makeTag(final int fieldNumber, final int wireType)
methods.comment: Makes a tag value given a field number and wire type.

methods.name: static Object readPrimitiveField(CodedInputStream input, FieldType type, Utf8Validation utf8Validation) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Read a field of any primitive type for immutable messages from a CodedInputStream. Enums,
   * groups, and embedded messages are not handled by this method.
   *
   * @param input The stream from which to read.
   * @param type Declared type of the field.
   * @param utf8Validation Different string UTF8 validation level for handling string fields.
   * @return An object representing the field's value, of the exact type which would be returned by
   *     {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)} for this field.
